Or is it a trap?..|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 13 ([[Cold Ambush]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Present3''' was an enemy that appeared on Wave 13 in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a decent amount of health, a slightly slow speed and 35% defense. Upon death, it would spawn three [[Present2 (Cold Ambush)|Present2]]s, which had lower health and shield health, no defense, but a faster speed. These also spawned a [[Present (Cold Ambush)|Present]] upon death. This would create huge hordes of enemies, which could easily overwhelm unprepared players. ==Appearance== The '''Present3''' was a humanoid present. The wrapping paper was a checker pattern of squares that were colored between tones of red and white. There was a white ribbon going across its head and torso, as well as a big white bow on its chest. It was slightly bigger than the average enemy. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **The [[Commander]] can be quite useful at decreasing the firerate of these towers. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be helpful by increasing the range of your towers and decreasing their upgrade costs. *As the '''Present3''' can create hordes of [[Present2 (Cold Ambush)|Present2]]s and [[Present (Cold Ambush)|Present]]s, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies, such as the [[Executioner]] or [[Engineer]], can be pretty great counters to this. ==Trivia== *The '''Present3''' was very similar to the Breaker enemies. Its appearance was quite similar to the [[Breaker3]], but its statistics and size resembled the statistics of the [[Breaker4]]. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Present3''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Present3''' removed. {{ColdAmbush|[[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)|Ripped Elf]]|Wave 12|Present3|Wave 13|[[Sleigh (Cold Ambush)|Sleigh]]|Wave 14}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Present3}}
